_: THE PTY-STATE PARITY CORPUS. One row per screen; `capture` names a sibling .txt read verbatim. Read by server/tests/pty_state_parity.rs (Rust: sessions::status) and web/tests/unit/pty-state-parity.test.ts (TypeScript: components/chat/peek-lens). Both assert the SAME verdict about the same bytes, because both planes have to agree that a session is blocked — the roster reads the server's, the chat surface reads the lens'. Provenance and the synthesized/live split are in README.md. `web` describes readLens(); `server` describes StatusDetector::classify() plus sessions::pty_state::read(). A null field means 'the plane must report nothing here'. `web.armed` records the keys the screen has ARMED (catalog generic.armed_keys) — an absent key makes no claim, an empty array is a control against an over-broad reader. `server.stalled` is the verbatim stall line, the one reading here that keeps a session ACTIVE rather than stopping it.
